title: AI Systems Engineering 技术雷达（高信号版）

signals.title: Codex-class agents need persistent, customer-controlled cloud workspaces
signals.summary: OpenAI's planned Ona acquisition is treated as a signal that high-value Codex work is moving from short local sessions toward long-running, secure, auditable execution environments with scoped credentials, activity logs, and review workflows.

signals.title: Hosted coding agents are becoming isolated runtime infrastructure
signals.summary: AWS AgentCore frames coding agents as production workloads that need isolated microVMs, persistent workspaces, deterministic command execution, identity, MCP gateway access, and observability rather than laptop-bound shells.

signals.title: Agentic coding workflows are entering CI/CD control planes
signals.summary: GitHub Agentic Workflows compiles natural-language task specifications into GitHub Actions, pulling issue triage, CI analysis, documentation updates, and repository maintenance into existing runner, policy, token, and sandbox systems.

signals.title: Agent infrastructure evaluation is shifting toward full task workloads
signals.summary: NVIDIA AgentPerf is captured as a signal that agent infrastructure should be evaluated on coding trajectories, tool calls, command execution, iteration, concurrency, cost, and energy rather than single-call tokens-per-second measurements.

signals.title: Managed agents need scheduling, secret boundaries, and connector observability
signals.summary: Anthropic's scheduled managed agents, vault-backed environment variables, and connector observability dashboard show hosted agents becoming operational backend workers with identity, secret injection, tool metrics, latency tracking, and health monitoring.

ideas.title: Remote Workspace Contract
ideas.summary: Design a minimal execution-substrate contract for coding agents with workspace lifecycle, deterministic command execution, credential scope, and audit events before building a full remote runtime.
